title: Apple App Store Developer Leads Input
description: Search the iOS App Store and extract developer leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: App topics to search for (e.g. invoice, meditation, crm, budgeting).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter store country code. Default US.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads scored per run.

maxPerKeyword.title: Max per keyword
maxPerKeyword.description: Cap apps taken from each keyword (iTunes returns up to 200).

minRatings.title: Minimum ratings
minRatings.description: Drop apps with fewer ratings than this. Zero keeps everything.

qualifiedMinRatings.title: Qualified rating bar
qualifiedMinRatings.description: Ratings at or above this, with a scraped email, tier a lead as qualified_lead.

includeEmail.title: Scrape contact emails
includeEmail.description: Fetch each seller website and scrape a contact email.

maxEmailLookups.title: Max email lookups
maxEmailLookups.description: Cap how many top leads get the website email scrape.
